Mushrooms are field crops unlocked at experience level 89.

They are used to make fish skewers, mushroom pasta, mushroom salad and mushroom soup.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for ??? coin.

Growing mushrooms

Mushrooms are grown in fields by planting mushroom (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 2 experience points, and takes 20 minutes to mature.

Selling mushrooms

  • Mushrooms can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 108 coin for 10 units.

Using mushrooms

Mushrooms are used to make the following products:


Mushroom Salad Cheese Fondue Fish Skewer
x3 x2 x3
Level 89 Level 91 Level 96
Mushroom Pot Pie Mushroom Pasta Mushroom Soup
x3 x5 x3
Level 97 Level 101 Level 104
Veggie Bouquet Winter Stew
x3 x2
Level 106 Level 112

Boat orders

Boat orders ask for 32 to 50 mushrooms per crate, up to a total of 150 per boat.

Strategy tips

  • Recipes ask for 2-5 mushrooms. You want to make sure you always have enough of them in your silo.
